Jordan F: quick follow-up from last night's postmortem re: alert storm. goal: reduce noisy pages while keeping visibility. propose small, staged work with clear owners.
Aisha M: +1. incremental only, no sweeping changes in prod.
Jordan F: proposed steps:
1) thresholds analysis for top noisy alerts (Aisha)
2) per-service dedupe aggregation (me)
3) 3-day staging test + single-region canary
Aisha M: I can take thresholds. i'll run 45-day p95/p99 and post a PR with suggested cutoffs + expected page reduction and FN risk. target 48h.
Jordan F: I'll implement dedupe as 3m consolidation + 15m suppression for identical signature. signature = "{{service}}:{{alert_key}}". config will live in alerts/infra/noise.
pager-bot: (automated) Incident #5012 resolved by jordan.f — creating follow-up task 'infra-alert-noise' assigned to [Jordan F, Aisha M] due 2025-06-10
Aisha M: i'll include dashboards and a CSV of trends in the PR. also add a short note about monitoring regressions.
ops-tasker: (automated) Task created: infra-alert-noise assigned to [Jordan F, Aisha M] due 2025-06-10
Jordan F: canary planned for 2025-06-11 on us-west-2 non-prod cluster. rollback playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra-noise
Aisha M: suggestion: tag tuned alerts with label "tuned-jun2025" and surface that in Slack notif for 2 weeks. helps oncall.
Jordan F: good call. i'll add label and update notif payload.
Aisha M: ack and will link PR here when ready.
Jordan F: ack — will post staging logs and results here. will also set a recurring 2-week noise sweep for 3 months after rollout and take first slot. :thumbsup:
